Game Overview

In 3d Isometric Puzzle, the core idea is straightforward: navigate through mesmerizing 3D isometric environments, strategically collapsing yellow tiles to reveal your path. With intuitive swipe controls, unravel each brain-teasing puzzle to stand victorious on the elusive Purple block. Let your problem-solving skills shine as you delve into this addictive and visually captivating challenge.
